Title: Visual Studio Subscription with GitHub Enterprise offering

Body.Content:
The new Visual Studio Subscription with GitHub Enterprise offering gives enterprise customers an easy and economical way to purchase Visual Studio Subscription and GitHub Enterprise at one low price. The offering enables you to innovate at scale by securely bringing open-source code, community and best practices into your enterprise projects. The native integrations of GitHub Enterprise with Visual Studio and Azure DevOps make it easier and faster for your development teams to adopt Git.

Learn more
